subject: Life Skills
title: Seasonal Rotation Strategy
description: A 60-second lesson on Seasonal Rotation Strategy.

hook.text: You wear about 20% of your clothes 80% of the time. The rest just take up visible closet space.

buildup.text: Winter coats in July and sandals in January compete for space with things you actually need now.

discovery.text: Seasonal rotation stores off-season items in bins elsewhere, freeing closets for current-use clothes only.

twist.text: If you open a stored bin next season and haven't missed anything inside, those items can be donated.

climax.text: Rotate twice a year: spring and fall. Use vacuum bags for bulky winter gear to save storage space.

punchline.text: Store what's sleeping. Display what you wear.

quiz.question: What does seasonal rotation help with?
options: Freeing closet space for current-season items
Reducing the need to do laundry
